item.title: Safe Kids Treasure Coast offering free pool alarms to Martin County residents
item.description: The Florida Department of Health and Safe Kids Treasure Coast are providing a limited supply of free pool alarms to qualifying Martin County residents with residential pools.

item.description: Port St. Lucie Police Department is investigating a double fatal shooting that occurred early Sunday morning in a residential neighborhood. item.title: Messi and Yamal Face Off in World Cup Final After Photo of Them Together as Infant and Teen
item.description: Photographer Joan Monfort took photos in 2007 of teenage Lionel Messi bathing infant Lamine Yamal for a charity calendar. The two faced each other Sunday in the World Cup final.

item.title: Britain's Josh Kerr Breaks Mile World Record With 3:42.66 in London
item.description: Josh Kerr broke Hicham El Guerrouj's 27-year-old mile world record on Saturday, running 3:42.66 at a Diamond League event in London.

item.title: Security Ramped Up for World Cup Final in New Jersey With Secret Service Perimeter
item.description: The World Cup final on Sunday in New Jersey will include a Secret Service perimeter and heightened security measures as President Trump attends the trophy presentation.

item.title: MLB Restricts Dugout iPad Use to Block AI Decision-Making Programs
item.description: Major League Baseball made custom tabs on dugout iPads inaccessible starting Wednesday to prevent teams from using artificial intelligence to help make in-game decisions.

item.title: Snyder Drives in Five as St. Lucie Mets Hold Off Cardinals, 8-6
item.description:
Trey Snyder delivered a career day at the plate Sunday as the St. Lucie Mets held off a late Palm Beach Cardinals rally for an 8-6 victory at Roger Dean Chevrolet Stadium.

item.title: Boca Raton TLC Program Offers Summer Service Projects for South Florida Families
item.description: B'nai Torah Congregation's TLC Program connects volunteers with hands-on service projects ranging from food support and shoe donations to pantry stocking and literacy efforts.

item.title: Two Martin County brush fires contained, more expected this summer
item.description: Martin County saw two brush fires this week, including one sparked by a lightning strike, both now fully contained and being monitored by the Florida Forest Service.

item.title: Unity in the Community event connects Fort Pierce families with public safety and services
item.description: The annual Unity in the Community event in Fort Pierce brought together families, police and community resources.
